observations: All 15 final screenshots were opened for visual inspection.
Chinese, English and Japanese starter, parameter and event views fit the 390px viewport with scrollable content and reachable Create, Cancel, Apply and Back controls.
Long native select/input text may clip within its own field; there is no horizontal dialog overflow.

Other collider navigation visibly selects the exact static body declaration. Publisher, animation and audio event links open the behavior document; their event provenance carries distinct /bindings/4, /bindings/0 and /bindings/3 properties but no sourceRange, so exact text selection is not claimed for those three links.
The audio view records two executed play commands, not audible hardware output.
